main_theorem.title: Large-N low-threshold stationary polygons are convex
main_theorem.statement_text: There is a universal \(N_0\) such that, for every \(N\ge N_0\), every admissible stationary simple \(N\)-gon \(P\) satisfying \[ J(P)\le J(R_{N-1}) \] is convex. Consequently, no such polygon satisfies \(J(P)<m_{N-1}\) while being non-convex.
